title: Longest Continuous Subarray With Absolute Diff Less Than or Equal to Limit
goal: Find the longest contiguous interval whose greatest and least values differ by at most limit.
strategy: Monotonic queues retain maximum and minimum candidates. Shrink the left boundary only while their difference violates the limit.
